# Ban Durations
You may submit a ban appeal in the #ban-appeal forum on the official AFTERLIGHT Discord server.
## Temporary Bans A ban that will be automatically lifted after a certain amount of time has elapsed.
## Indefinite Bans A ban that will only be removed upon a successful appeal on the forums. Any ban without an explicitly shown expiration date can be presumed to be an indefinite ban, assuming it does not specify otherwise. Occasionally referred to as an "appeal ban".
## Voucher Bans A ban which may only be appealed with a successful appeal and a voucher of good behavior from the administrative team of a well-known, decently active SS13/SS14 server. A voucher is required in order for the appeal to be considered. Voucher bans typically cannot be appealed for at least six months after being issued. Without a voucher, a player can only attempt to appeal a voucher ban once if they believe the ban was inappropriately placed. Voucher bans are typically only placed as a result of an unsuccessful appeal of an indefinite game ban by players who have a history of causing issues and receiving bans.
## Permanent Bans A ban that is only appealable if the ban was inappropriately placed or should not have been permanent. If the result of the appeal is that the ban was appropriately placed, the ban may not be appealed again and will not be lifted. These bans are extremely rare, but are applied to players who continually cause problems even after a voucher ban or users who have completely unacceptable behavior may be permanently removed.
